    df = df.copy()

    required = ['speed', 'reader_view', 'dyslexia_bin', 'num_words', 'page_id', 'uuid']

    df = df.dropna(subset=['speed', 'reader_view', 'dyslexia_bin', 'num_words', 'page_id', 'uuid'])
